title: Happy pig
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#ff9ec4'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#ffc2d8'/>

  <path d='M26 30 L22 14 L40 24 Z' fill='#f27bab'/>
  <path d='M74 30 L78 14 L60 24 Z' fill='#f27bab'/>
  <path d='M29 28 L27 20 L37 26 Z' fill='#ffc2d8'/>

  <ellipse cx='54' cy='44' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c94f84'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 53 Q50 58 57 53' stroke='#c94f84' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M80 58 q9 -4 6 4 q-3 7 2 4' stroke='#f27bab' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
